---
title: "Parameter Tables"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(here)
```

## Pathogen archetype parameters

```{r}
table1_pathogen <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Basic reproduction number ($R_0$)",
    "Mean incubation period (days)",
    "Mean infectious period (days)",
    "Mean duration of immunity (days)"
  ),
  SARS_CoV_2_like = c(
    "2.5",
    "2",
    "4",
    "365"
  ),
  Influenza_like = c(
    "1.5",
    "1",
    "2",
    "365"
  ),
  Source_Reference = c(
    "Liu et al. 2020; Biggerstaff et al. 2014",
    "?",
    "?",
    "?"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

table1_pathogen |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Pathogen archetype natural history parameters") |>
  cols_label(
    Parameter = "Parameter",
    SARS_CoV_2_like = "SARS-CoV-2-like",
    Influenza_like = "Influenza-like",
    Source_Reference = "Source"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Parameter, Source_Reference)) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(SARS_CoV_2_like, Influenza_like))
```

## Model parameters

```{r}
table2_model <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    # Population Structure
    "Population size",
    "Age groups",
    "Household size distribution",
    "School enrollment distribution",
    "Workplace size distribution",
    # Transmission Dynamics
    "Household transmission proportion",
    "School/Workplace transmission proportion",
    "Leisure transmission proportion",
    "Community transmission proportion",
    "Between-location heterogeneity (gamma)",
    # Time Allocation
    "Hours per day in household",
    "Hours per day in school/workplace",
    "Hours per day in leisure venues",
    "Hours per day in community",
    # Indoor Air Quality & Ventilation
    "Pathogen decay constant (k_D, h^-1)",
    "Viral emission rate (virions/person/h)",
    "Breathing rate (m^3/h)",
    "Infection probability per virion",
    "Room height (m)",

    "School occupancy density (per 100m^2)",
    "Workplace occupancy density (per 100m^2)",

    # Transmission Dynamics

    "12",
    "8",
    "2.5",
    "1.5",
    # Indoor Air Quality & Ventilation
    "0.64",
    "27",
    "0.45",
    "0.0137",
    "2.5",
    "5",
    "30",
    "10",
    "50",
    "Setting-specific",

    "—",
    "—",
    "—",

    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Distribution sampled",
    "Distribution sampled",
    "Distribution sampled",
    # Transmission Dynamics
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Variance from ACH data",
    # Time Allocation
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    # Indoor Air Quality & Ventilation
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Fixed",
    "Lognormal per setting",

    "40%, 60%, 80%",
    "0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%",

    "Fixed",
    "Fixed"
  ),
  Source_Reference = c(
    # Population Structure
    "Model specification",
    "Model specification",
    "RTI International 2010 (Rineer et al. 2025)",

    "Ferguson et al. 2005",
    # Transmission Dynamics

    "Ferretti et al. 2024",
    "Ferretti et al. 2024",
    "Residual transmission",
    "Corsi et al.",
    # Time Allocation
    "Model assumption",
    "Model assumption",
    "Model assumption",
    "Model assumption",
    # Indoor Air Quality & Ventilation
    "Blatchley & Cui 2023",
    "Blatchley & Cui 2023",
    "Blatchley & Cui 2023",
    "Blatchley & Cui 2023; Killingley et al. 2022",
    "Standard assumption",
    "ASHRAE 62.1 (Kelechava 2022)",
    "ASHRAE 62.1 (Kelechava 2022)",
    "ASHRAE 62.1 (Kelechava 2022)",
    "ASHRAE 62.1 (Kelechava 2022)",
    "Corsi et al.",
    # Air Quality Interventions
    "Sensitivity analysis",
    "Sensitivity analysis",
    "Sensitivity analysis",
    "Model specification",
    "Model specification"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

table2_model |>
  mutate(
    Category = c(
      rep("Population structure", 5),
      rep("Transmission dynamics", 5),
      rep("Time allocation", 4),
      rep("Indoor air quality and ventilation", 10),
      rep("Air quality interventions", 5)
    )
  ) |>
  select(Category, everything()) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Category") |>
  tab_header(title = "Model parameters") |>
  cols_label(
    Parameter = "Parameter",
    Baseline_Value = "Baseline value",
    Sensitivity_Range = "Sensitivity range",
    Source_Reference = "Source"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Parameter, Source_Reference)) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Baseline_Value, Sensitivity_Range))
```

## Simulation parameters

```{r}
table3_simulation <- data.frame(
  Setting = c(
    "Pathogen archetype",
    "AQI efficacy",
    "AQI coverage",
    "AQI deployment",
    "Transmission regime"
  ),
  Values = c(
    "SARS-CoV-2-like; Influenza-like",
    "40%, 60%, 80%",
    "0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%",
    "Random; Risk-targeted",
    "Endemic; epidemic"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

table3_simulation |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Simulation parameters") |>
  cols_label(
    Setting = "Setting",
    Values = "Values"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Setting, Values))
```
